# ✨ More Gold – A Vanilla‑Friendly Gold-Themed Mod
More Gold enriches your Minecraft world with a wide range of new gold‑infused items, blocks, foods, and utilities—designed to feel exactly like something Mojang could have added themselves.
Inspired by classics like Golden Apples and Golden Carrots, this mod expands the golden theme into a full progression system that stays perfectly balanced and lore‑friendly.
# Features
- New Golden Foods
Discover shimmering recipes that offer unique buffs while staying true to vanilla balance. Perfect for adventurers who want a little extra shine in their diet.
 
- Gold‑Infused Items
Craft new items that enhance exploration, and farming. Lightweight and unmistakably golden.
- Decorative & Functional Golden Blocks
Build with new block variants that blend seamlessly with vanilla textures. From subtle accents to full golden structures, your builds will gleam like never before.
- Vanilla‑Friendly Progression
Every addition is carefully designed to feel natural in the Minecraft universe—no overpowered gear, no tech systems, just pure golden goodness.
- More Surprises to Discover
Hidden recipes, special interactions, and small details reward players who love exploring and experimenting.
# 💛 A Shine That Feels Right at Home
Whether you're a builder, explorer, or survival purist, Golden Expansion adds fresh content without breaking the classic Minecraft experience. It’s simple, elegant, and perfectly golden.
